title: Upcoming Events – Winter Spring 2024
html:
After Fosdem and Astricon that happened during February 2024, a series of events follow where you can meet Kamailio developers and community members:

  • Mobile World Congress, Barcelona, Spain – Feb 26-29, 2024
  • Call Center World, Berlin, Germany – Feb 27-29, 2024
  • IETF 119, Brisbane, Australia – Mar 16-22, 2024
  • FOSSASIA Summit, Hanoi, Vietnam – Apr 8-10, 2024
  • Open Source Mobile Network Technologies Conference, Berlin Germany – Apr 17, 2024
  • Kamailio World Conference, Berlin, Germany – Apr 18-19, 2024
  • Hannover Messe, Hannover, Germany – Apr 22-26, 2024
  • Janus Conference, Naples, Italy – Apr 29-30, 2024

If you are part of our community and participate to other events not listed here, ideally presenting also about Kamailio, let us know and we will list them.

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
